Dyrego on Manglerud has become my go-to place in the storm of disappearing aquarium shops in Oslo. When you have a hobby that involves balancing chemicals, frozen food, and fish that look like little pieces of swimming art, it's a godsend to have a place that still delivers.

They have it all: fish, plants, frozen food, and an arsenal of equipment that would impress even a NASA engineer (if NASA ran aquariums, that is).

They also have food and equipment for everything from dogs and cats to birds, rabbits, and probably even a dragon, if you can find one. Yes, you can even bring home a new family member - whether it's a feathered or furry variety.

This isn't just a store, it's a zoological experience with everything you need to keep both your aquarium and your animal flock at home happy. So, whether you're the type of person who can spend hours staring at guppies or just need dog food, Dyrego is a great option.

Yesterday I bought some plants and fish for my aquarium. The employee in the aquarium department was very nice and had a lot of knowledge about plants and fish species, you could hear how much he was interested and enjoyed this hobby. It was a very nice conversation. I hope the store appreciates his commitment. I will definitely go back there👍
